objective: Roadmap A A15 O05/O06/O07: offline immutable cost evidence, safe retry intent state and honest read-only operating status; enables A16 evidence reconciliation.
scope_out: Crypto attestation of user-supplied provider receipts
HostOps and Git Write Guard changes
acceptance: User-supplied and synthetic CHARGED costs are distinct from independently verified real provider cost; PENDING and UNKNOWN are not zero.
Decimal string amount, explicit uppercase currency; no FX aggregation, no floating-point money.
Immutable cost event/intent/attempt replay is idempotent; conflicting bytes fail closed.
Ambiguous provider effects require reconciliation and cannot be retried automatically; stale last-attempt view is held.
Read-only job status preserves render/publication/link/order/settlement separation and never implies business revenue.
Exact-head focused and affected CI on both hosted operating systems plus reviewed registry mapping; no unknown skipped required test.
risk_notes: O01-O04 exist in A04 code and must be reused instead of reimplemented; WorkTree status PROPOSED is stale for O01-O04.
The first integrated review PR will not be called M5 accepted until exact-head hosted CI and Brain review.
Provider-supplied charge receipts cannot be certified by an offline ledger. No real settlement/revenue evidence.
